versions.content: An RTE_E_DET_ILLEGAL_SIGNAL_ID (0x01) shall be reported at runtime by the RTE when it receives a COM callback for a signal name (e.g. Rte_COMCbk_<sn> , Rte_COMCbkTAck_<sn> ) which was not expected within the context of the currently-selected postBuild variant. See section 5.9.2.1 for the list of possible COM callback template API.
